decisions.reason: As a two-component spraying system that builds directly on the firm's core application-equipment knowledge, it fits existing absorptive capacity well and its continued website presence suggests enough promise to retain it.

Although the available evidence refers to an earlier test phase, the product remains prominently presented and is close to the firm's established injection know-how, so management would more likely continue learning and refining than withdraw it.
This product line reuses proven WIWA air-motor technology and extends a familiar pump application area, giving the firm very strong related knowledge and a strong basis to keep and improve it.

Fire protection flow monitoring broadens the firm's systems offer toward more integrated solutions, and with in-house R&D plus research links the firm is well placed to absorb feedback and continue developing it rather than drop it.

It is the newest launch and has the shortest market record, but because it is close to the firm's established two-component spraying capabilities, management would likely keep it on the market while gathering and applying early customer learning.
